catalogue.note: The popup sits over a real background blur: Figma’s blur 8 is backdrop-filter: blur(4px) on a 40% #F4F4F4 layer from y135 down. The card is placed at its metadata x=40 rather than 50% minus half its width, which Chrome snaps to 40.5. The “Got it” button sits at x126.5 in Figma; Chrome snaps it to whole pixels. This frame’s heading reads “Nominated beneficiary” in the file. The 10, 14 and 16px strings drew 1px higher than Figma in Chrome, so they carry a measured 1px correction. The 12, 20, 24 and 28px strings needed none.
